title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Exodus 16: the quail and the manna in the wilderness of Sin, and the Sabbath rest.

questions.text: Into which wilderness did the congregation come after leaving Elim?
questions.explanation: They came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai.

questions.text: What did the people wish when they murmured against Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: They said they wished they had died by Yahweh's hand in Egypt, when they sat by the meat pots and ate their fill of bread.

answers.text: That they had stayed at Elim
That Aaron had led them instead
That they had gone by the way of the Philistines
That they had died by Yahweh's hand in Egypt

questions.text: How much were they to gather on the sixth day?
questions.explanation: On the sixth day what they brought in would be twice as much as they gathered daily.

questions.text: What came up and covered the camp in the evening?
questions.explanation: In the evening quail came up and covered the camp, and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

questions.text: What did Moses say the small round thing on the ground was?
questions.explanation: When they asked 'What is it?', Moses said: 'It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.'

answers.text: The bread Yahweh had given them to eat
Salt left behind by the sea
Honey that had dripped from the rocks
Seed for sowing in the fields

questions.text: How much were they to gather for each person?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commanded them to gather an omer a head, according to the number of their persons.

questions.text: What happened to the manna that some left until the morning?
questions.explanation: Some did not listen to Moses and left it until morning, and it bred worms and became foul.

answers.text: It bred worms and became foul

questions.text: What happened when some people went out to gather on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

answers.text: They found it full of worms

questions.text: What was the taste of the manna like?
questions.explanation: Manna was like coriander seed, white, and its taste was like wafers with honey.

questions.text: How long did the children of Israel eat the manna?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.
